title: Blocking of Websites Linked to Misinformation Campaigns and Subsequent Appeals Process
what_it_is: Blocking of Websites Linked to Misinformation Campaigns and Subsequent Appeals Process

sections.label: Blocked inauthentic websites, IMDA directions
sections.summary: IMDA directed Internet Access Service Providers to disable access to 10 inauthentic websites, with appeals possible to the Minister under the Broadcasting Act.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: In the case of 10 inauthentic websites that were blocked on 22 October 2024, the level of exposure of Singaporeans to these 10 websites were assessed to be low.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: However, based on our investigations, they could potentially be used by foreign actors to mount HICs against Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA) had considered the MHA’s findings and was satisfied that it was in the public interest to take pre-emptive action and not wait until a HIC is mounted before acting against these websites.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The directions to Internet Access Service Providers to disable access to the 10 inauthentic websites were issued with the intent of protecting users in Singapore from accessing and potentially being misled by these inauthentic websites.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: However, if individuals choose to circumvent these protections and use virtual private networks or other means to access dubious content, they do so at their own risk.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Under section 59 of the Broadcasting Act, any licensee aggrieved by any decision of the IMDA may appeal to the Minister.

sections.label: Public education and communication campaigns
sections.summary: The Government ran public education efforts including the National Library Board's SURE campaign and the annual Total Defence campaign.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: The Government has conducted public education efforts and communication campaigns.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: These include the National Library Board's SURE campaign, which stands for Source, Understand, Research and Evaluate, to impart critical thinking skills to help Singaporeans discern the reliability of information, as well as the annual Total Defence campaign that reminds Singaporeans of the part that they need to play to counter hybrid threats.
